text: Liquid Glass 为 DSH 桌面端深色界面添加液态玻璃风格，通过 webServer 提供启动脚本和样式，并由客户端模块注册设置界面。它美化输入框、用户与助手消息、侧栏、顶栏和菜单，加入模糊、光泽高光、背景条纹及性能档位控制；可与壁纸插件配合。适合希望调整 DSH 桌面外观的用户，需要 DSH 桌面端并使用深色模式。

Liquid Glass gives DSH desktop a dark glass look. It serves styles and a boot loader through webServer, with a client settings panel. It styles the composer, messages, sidebar, top bar, and menus with blur and pointer highlights, plus performance tiers. Requires DSH desktop and dark mode.
想给 DSH 桌面换成深色玻璃质感界面。
有没有能美化 DSH 输入框和消息气泡的主题？
让 DSH 侧栏、顶栏和菜单也有半透明模糊效果。
我想给聊天界面加玻璃高光和背景效果。
DSH 桌面界面怎么配合壁纸做玻璃风格？
能否按电脑性能调节界面模糊效果？
How can I give the DSH desktop a dark glass-style interface?
I want translucent blur styling for the composer, chat bubbles, and sidebar in DSH.
Liquid Glass 的功能「composer」：为输入框应用半透明模糊材质与指针高光。 样式随 DSH 页面启动加载。
Liquid Glass 的功能「messages」：为用户消息气泡和助手内容卡片添加玻璃边缘、渐变和阴影样式。 样式随 DSH 页面启动加载。
Liquid Glass 的功能「surfaces」：为侧栏、顶栏、菜单等界面区域应用协调的玻璃材质。 样式随 DSH 页面启动加载。
Liquid Glass 的功能「backdrop」：在没有壁纸层时提供条纹背景，并在检测到其它全屏背景层时让出背景。 样式随 DSH 页面启动加载。
Liquid Glass 的功能「quality」：提供性能档位以控制模糊等视觉效果。 样式随 DSH 页面启动加载。
Liquid Glass 使用深色主题配色，项目说明当前仅支持深色模式；浅色界面不在支持范围内。（见 artifacts/50-glass-surfaces.css:64）

dsh-plugin-liquid-glass README · dsh-plugin-liquid-glass：适用于 DSH 桌面端的液态玻璃美化插件。输入框、消息气泡、侧栏与顶栏等主要界面元素
改为液态玻璃材质，可搭配各类壁纸插件使用（需深色模式）。

> Liquid-glass beautification plugin for DSH desktop. Gives the composer, message
> bubbles, sidebar, top bar and menus a liquid-glass material. Works alongside
> wallpaper plugins. Dark mode only.

**覆盖范围**（市场会拿描述对代码核查，所以写清楚实际做了什么）：
输入框 · 用户消息气泡 · 助手回复卡片 · 侧栏工作区块 · 顶栏与标签页 ·
右侧栏面板 · 侧栏控件药丸 · 菜单与弹窗材质。
材质为半透明玻璃：底色 + 背景模糊 + 内高光 + 细描边 + 投影。

dsh-plugin-liquid-glass README · dsh-plugin-liquid-glass：> ⚠ **措辞备注**：此处原来写的是"输入框（真折射）"。当前发布版（0.1.72）的材质是
> **背景模糊（backdrop-filter: blur）**，不含位移折射 ——
> `git show HEAD:artifacts/client.js` 里 `dsh-lens` 出现 0 次。
> 折射（SVG 高度场 + feDisplacementMap 透镜）那一版保留在
> `snapshot/lens-refraction` 分支上，**未合入主线**，因此也不在本发布版里。
> 市场会拿描述对代码核查，所以这里不写"折射"，等它真正发布后再改回来。

**与壁纸插件的关系**：按"能力"而非"品牌"判定是否已有壁纸在场，分三层探测
（显式契约 / 各家已知钩子 / 通用结构判据），因此**各种壁纸插件都能搭配使用**。
你也可以用 `data-dsh-glass-canvas="off"` 显式关掉插件自带的背景。

dsh-plugin-liquid-glass README · dsh-plugin-liquid-glass：> **状态：v0.1.72（已发布到 npm）**
>
> - **三个可调开关**（「设置 → 液态玻璃」）：**省token建议** / **启用开场动画** /
>   **启动DSH后进入新会话**。后两者联动 —— 开场动画不可用（开关关闭，或画质档位为
>   极低/低）时，「进入新会话」会置灰并按关闭处理。
>   关掉开场动画后，插件**整套启动介入一起停**（不注入任何可见性闸门、不建黑场、
>   取消入场编排），启动流程交回 DSH 官方加载。
> - **首次安装会问一次画质**。装好后第一次启动（等开场动画演完）会弹出五档选择，
>   让你自己挑一个 —— 不同机器的显卡能力差别很大，选高了会卡。
>   之后随时可以在「设置 → 液态玻璃」里改。
> - **只适配 DSH 桌面端**。浏览器环境会**整体停用**（不注册任何 UI、不改动界面），
>   并弹一次说明。这不是"没测过浏览器"，是明确不支持。
> - **暂不适配浅色模式**。材质只针对深色底调过，所以外观会被锁定在深色；
>   点「浅色」或「跟随系统」会被拦下并说明原因。
>   如需解除锁定：在 `~/.dsh/` 下创建空文件 `glass-theme-lock-off`。
> - 已在 Windows 桌面端实测（材质、开场、主题锁定、更新通道均可用）。

| 开关 | 查到 | npm dist-tag | 说明 |
|---|---|---|---|

| 地址 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| `github.com` | 超时 12 秒 |
| `raw.githubusercontent.com` | 连不上 |
| `registry.npmmirror.com`（npm 镜像） | 200 OK，57 ms |

所以：**GitHub 用来给人看代码，npm 用来给用户下载**（国内自动走镜像加速）。
`github:` 源还有一个缺点：它拉取**整个仓库**，没有裁剪机制。
npm 侧靠 `files` 白名单 + `.npmignore` 裁到约 2.5 MB。

dsh-plugin-liquid-glass README · 官方 Electron 桌面端：桌面端的 `desktop` profile **由应用独占管理**，CLI 会直接拒绝：

```
error: profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application
```

绕开方式：把配置复制成一个临时 profile 名安装，再把配方同步回去。

```powershell
$P = "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\profiles"
Copy-Item "$P\desktop" "$P\glass-tmp" -Recurse
dsh plugin --profile glass-tmp add link:<本目录绝对路径>

dsh-plugin-liquid-glass README · 同步配方（保留 desktop 原有的 cordis.patch.yml）：foreach ($f in 'package.json','pnpm-lock.yaml','cordis.patch.yml','cordis.yml','pnpm-workspace.yaml') {
  Copy-Item "$P\glass-tmp\$f" "$P\desktop\$f" -Force
}
robocopy "$P\glass-tmp\node_modules" "$P\desktop\node_modules" /E
Remove-Item "$P\glass-tmp" -Recurse -Force
```

text:
dsh-plugin-liquid-glass README · 为什么用「结构化注入行」而不是 `tapIndex`：这是本插件最关键的设计决定，也是踩坑换来的。

`dsh web` 和官方 Electron 桌面端**把页面送上屏幕的方式完全不同**：

```
dsh web        DSH web 服务器提供 index.html
               → tapIndex 的字符串改写能到达页面

Electron 桌面端  页面由 dsh-app:// 协议从磁盘直读

桌面端真正认可的是**结构化注入表**：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop-host` 会调用
`ctx.webServer.collectIndexInjections()`，把行通过 boot payload 发给页面侧解释器。

行类型是闭集（读自 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-webserver`）：

```
global | script | script-src | script-preload | style | html
```
section: 为什么用「结构化注入行」而不是 `tapIndex`

text:
dsh-plugin-liquid-glass README · 为什么用「结构化注入行」而不是 `tapIndex`：**注意没有 `style-src`** —— 外部样式表无法表达为行，所以 CSS 作为**内联
`style` 文本**下发。这同时是更稳的选择：整个效果不依赖任何路由可达。

插件优先用结构化行（两端通吃），`tapIndex` 仅作为老版本运行时的回退。

wallpaper plugin can be used alongside this one**. You can also opt out of the
plugin's own background explicitly with `data-dsh-glass-canvas="off"`.

dsh-plugin-liquid-glass README · dsh-plugin-liquid-glass：> **Status: v0.1.72 (published to npm)**
>
> - **Three toggles** (`Settings → Liquid Glass`): **token-saving advice**, **intro
>   animation**, and **start in a new session**. The last two are interlocked: when the
>   intro is unavailable (switched off, or the quality tier is Very low / Low) the
>   new-session toggle is greyed out and treated as off. Turning the intro off also
>   stops the plugin's entire boot involvement — no visibility gates, no black cover,

> - **DSH desktop only.** In a browser the plugin disables itself entirely (registers
>   no UI, changes nothing) and shows a one-time notice. This is a deliberate
>   limitation, not an untested path.

dsh-plugin-liquid-glass README · Option 1: run the installer script (easiest)：Download **`install-liquid-glass.cmd`** from this repo's Releases page and double-click it.
It locates DSH's bundled command-line tool on its own, runs the install below, and tells
you whether it worked.

dsh-plugin-liquid-glass README · Option 1: run the installer script (easiest)：> **The file in the repository is named `安装插件.cmd` - it is the same file.**
> GitHub Release asset names do not support Chinese, and uploading it under that name
> silently degrades to a meaningless `default.cmd`, so the Release asset uses an English
> name while the source file keeps the Chinese one. Identical content (3515 bytes, same SHA-256).

dsh-plugin-liquid-glass README · Option 1: run the installer script (easiest)：> **It installs from npm, not directly from this repository.** The sources contain no build
> output, and installing from a `github:` source via pnpm 10+ triggers the `allowBuilds`
> approval prompt. Going through npm is more reliable and is automatically mirrored in China.
> So this route **does not need the plugin marketplace**, but it does still need a network.

dsh-plugin-liquid-glass README · Option 2: command line：```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-plugin-liquid-glass
```

dsh-plugin-liquid-glass README · Option 3: plugin marketplace：Search for "liquid glass". The code is identical to the other routes; the marketplace is
just another entry point.

---

**Either way, restart DSH afterwards** — the material stylesheets are injected at boot.

**On first launch it asks once for a quality level** (after the intro finishes). Pick one
that suits your machine - too high causes stutter. Change it later in Settings -> Liquid Glass.

dsh-plugin-liquid-glass README · Uninstall：```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-plugin-liquid-glass
```

The plugin only injects styles; it never modifies DSH's own files, so removing it
restores the stock appearance.

dsh-plugin-liquid-glass README · What it does：| Surface | Effect | Layer |
|---|---|---|
| Composer (input box) | Translucent glass — background blur + pointer-following highlight | Navigation |
| User message bubble | Glass look — self-lit gradient, hairline edge, inner highlight | Content |
| Assistant card | Glass look + 900px narrowing + smooth growth | Content |

dsh-plugin-liquid-glass README · What it does：> ⚠ **Factual correction:** this table used to read
> "**True refraction** — SVG displacement map + blur + pointer highlight" for the
> composer. In release 0.1.72 the composer's material is a background blur only
> (`backdrop-filter: blur(var(--dsh-glass-blur, 32px)) saturate(...) brightness(...)`);
> there is no SVG displacement map in the shipped code. The refraction version lives on
> the `snapshot/lens-refraction` branch and is not merged into main. The paragraph below
> describes the *design intent* that
> the refraction work is meant to serve — it is kept for context, not as a claim
> about the current release.

dsh-plugin-liquid-glass README · What it does：On the navigation / content distinction: Apple stated at WWDC25 that glass belongs
to the **navigation layer**. The composer floats above scrolling content, so there
is something continuous behind it that a refraction pass *could* sample. Message
content sits on a flat transcript, so refracting it would distort the text and hurt
readability — those get the glass *look* only. The distinction is a requirement,
not a preference.

dsh-plugin-liquid-glass README · Settings：- **Quality tier** — Very low / Low / Medium / High / Very high.
  Lower tiers drop the blur (the expensive part) and, at the lowest tiers, skip the
  intro. Changing this **requires a DSH restart** to fully apply.
- **Token-saving advice** — shows or hides the suggestion strip under the top bar.
  Only meaningful if you do not already run a token-saving plugin.
- **Intro animation** — the black cover, the video and the title reveal. On by default;
  the two lowest quality tiers cannot enable it (that is a performance guard, so the
  toggle is greyed out there rather than silently ignored).
- **Start in a new session** — on: launch lands in a blank session, which is what the
  intro's composer beat is designed around; off: the last conversation is reopened.
  Greyed out (and treated as off) whenever the intro is unavailable.
- **Snapshot updates** — off by default (stable channel). Turning it on switches
  "Check for updates" to the snapshot channel.
- **Check for updates** — queries the channel you selected.

dsh-plugin-liquid-glass README · Settings：Two release channels are kept apart by npm dist-tag **and** a prerelease suffix:
snapshots carry `-snapshot.<date>.<random>`, which always sorts *below* the same
stable version, so a snapshot can never supersede a stable release.

dsh-plugin-liquid-glass README · Open source, and what that means for modifications：**2. You can tell in five seconds whether it was modified.** In the plugin
directory:

```bash
node verify-integrity.mjs
```

It compares every file against the published SHA-256 manifest:

- "**unmodified**" → this is the official build; please report problems
- "**this code has been changed**" → reinstall the official build before debugging

**3. To restore the official build, just reinstall:**

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-plugin-liquid-glass
```

dsh-plugin-liquid-glass README · Requirements：- DSH desktop (Electron). The plugin detects the runtime via
  `<html data-platform>` — the same signal DSH's own `detectEnvironment()` uses.
  No `data-platform` means a browser, and the plugin stays off.

dsh-plugin-liquid-glass README · Known limitations：1. **Light mode is not supported yet.** The materials are tuned for dark
   backgrounds, so the appearance is locked to dark.
   To unlock: create an empty file `glass-theme-lock-off` in `~/.dsh/`.
2. **Desktop only.** In a browser the plugin disables itself entirely.
3. **Native white window background.** For roughly one second between the window
   appearing and the page's first frame, the system's light background is visible
   (harsh under a dark theme). This is decided by DSH's own window configuration in
   the main process — **the plugin cannot fix it** (there is no IPC channel for it).
4. **Class-name hashes.** Some CSS selectors match on build-time generated class
   hashes, which may differ between `dsh-web-frontend` versions.

dsh-plugin-liquid-glass README · Troubleshooting: enabling the diagnostic log：Diagnostics are **off by default** (when enabled, one launch writes ~277 lines /
40 KB into the plugin directory). To turn them on — no code changes needed:

```js
// run in the console, then reload the page
localStorage.setItem('dsh-glass-probe', '1')
```
- or append `?dshGlassProbe=1` to the URL
- or run `window.__dshGlassProbe = true` in the console (takes effect on the next launch)

dsh-plugin-liquid-glass README · Troubleshooting: enabling the diagnostic log：The timeline is then written to `artifacts/startup-timeline.log`.
**Turn it back off when done:** `localStorage.removeItem('dsh-glass-probe')`.
